title: Convert Python modules to C#
problem_statement: The current Python codebase needs to be converted to C# to meet modernization objectives.
risk_if_unaddressed: Failure to meet modernization objectives and potential security risks.
suggested_approach: Use automated tools to convert Python code to C# and manually refactor for idiomatic C# practices.
success_criteria: All modules are successfully converted to C#.
Legacy behavior is preserved in the new C# codebase.
